definitions.content:
name: github_release_day_change
label: 'GitHub on GTA 6 release day: PRs opened'
description: Metric 4 headline. Change, in percent, of pull requests opened on GitHub on GTA 6's release
  day (Thu 19 Nov 2026, UTC) against the Thursday before (12 Nov 2026). -4 = 4% fewer PRs opened. Report
  it with its breakdown (group by github_release_day__breakdown, or query github_activity_change by github_activity__activity),
  which also gives PRs merged and commits.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: github_release_day_change_measure
